card.name: Words leading up to listening for sounds
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'listen' or 'listening', such as in descriptions of using a stethoscope or Pinard horn to hear body sounds. Also fires on parts of related terms like auscultation.

modes.label: Stethoscope exam phrasing
modes.description: Words in a physical exam sentence where the doctor places a stethoscope to listen for sounds.
modes.example: Your doctor will place a stethoscope on your abdomen<< to>> listen for bowel sounds.
